lines: Wave of Frost now has 275% more Freeze Buildup at all Levels (from 150% scaling up over levels).

Concoction skills from the Pathfinder Ascendancy Class now consume 3 charges from Mana Flasks (from 5). Their damage has been increased and deal approximately 66% more Damage when the skill is Level 20. In addition the base added damage has been increased by at least 50% for all Concoction skills, with Poisonous and Bleeding Concoction receiving greater damage buffs. Fulminating Concoction now has a Critical Strike Chance of 8% (from 6%), Shattering Concoction now has a Critical Strike Chance of 11% (from 7%), Explosive Concoction now has 100% more chance to Ignite Enemies and 100% more magnitude of Ignites inflicted, Fulminating Concoction now has 100% more chance to inflict Shock and Shattering Concoction now has 100% more Freeze Buildup.
It is now more difficult to chain-freeze enemies, by reducing the amount of Freeze Buildup applied after a Freeze has been applied.
Fixed a bug where Ice Shot was unable to cause Freeze buildup.
Updated the description on The Three Dragons Unique to clarify that Cold Damage from Hits does not contribute to Freeze Buildup.
Freeze now builds up roughly 48% slower on enemies.

Added a new multi-choice Practical Remedies Ascendancy Passive Skill that provides the ability to allocate Grounding Stick, Dousing Vial, or Thawing Campfire, which provide Immunity to Shock, Immunity to Ignite, and Immunity to Freeze respectively.
Combat Frenzy now has Gain a Frenzy Charge when you Freeze, Electrocute or Pin an enemy, no more than once every 5.3-4.1 seconds at Gem levels 8-20 (previously 2.48-1.58).

Elemental Invocation now gains 10 Energy per Power of enemies you Freeze with Hits from Skills (previously 10), 2 Energy per Power of enemies you Ignite with Hits from Skills, modified by the percentage of the enemy's Ailment Threshold the Ignite will deal (previously 3). It also now gains 1 Energy per Power of enemies you Shock with Hits from Skills (previously 3).
Escape Shot now scales Freeze Buildup with Gem level, up to 585% more at Gem level 20 (previously 300% at all levels). Quality is now 0-120% more Freeze Buildup (previously 0-80%).

Fireball no longer bypasses the Raging Spirit limit. The secondary Fireball projectiles are no longer affected by additional projectiles, this was mostly to prevent performance issues when used with Wildshards Support.
Freezing Shards now fires 5 projectiles (previously 7), and now has 100% more Freeze Buildup (previously 50%).
Freezing Salvo now scales Freeze Buildup with Gem level, up to 107% more at Gem level 20 (previously 50% at all levels).
Permafrost Bolts now scales Freeze Buildup with Gem level, up to 186% more at Gem level 20 (previously 80% at all levels).
Shard Scavenger now instantly reloads your Crossbow upon Consuming Freeze, Shock, Ignite, or Fully Broken Armour, no more than once every 7.3-6.1 seconds at Gem levels 8-20 (previously 9.3-8.2).
Shattering Concoction now has 200% more Freeze Buildup (previously 100%).
Wave of Frost now has 390-585% more Freeze Build up at Gem levels 7-20 (previously 275% at all Gem levels).
Frost Nexus now causes Supported Skills to create Chilled Ground for 8 seconds when they Freeze an Enemy (previously 4).
The Death's Harp Unique Bow now has +30-40% to Critical Damage Bonus (previously +50-70%). Existing items can be made worse with a Divine Orb.
Fixed a bug where Thorns were not causing Stun, Freeze, Electrocute, Pin, Armour Break, Daze, nor Knockback.
Fixed a bug where some Fireball traps in the Trial of the Sekhemas were terminating early on terrain.

Elemental Sundering now pauses the Freeze, Shock and Ignites on targets when building up to explode, and now consumes them when exploding. Previously the ailment was removed as soon as the buildup began, this change has been made so targets remain frozen until the explosion.

The Freeze Buildup from Ice Nova and Ice Nova when cast near a Frostbolt are now matching. Ice Nova now has 100-157% more Freeze Buildup at Gem levels 1-20 (previously 50% only when cast on Frostbolt).
Headhunter now steals enemy modifiers for 60 seconds (previously 20 seconds). This change automatically affects existing items.
Added a new Intelligence Persistent Buff Gem — Siphon Elements: While active, has a chance to create an Infusion Remnant when you Freeze, Shock or Ignite a target.
Ice Crystals will now instantly shatter from hits that could Consume Freeze. As this is now default behaviour, Glacial Cascade and Fragmentation Rounds no longer specifically call out this behaviour.

The Consuming Questions Notable has been renamed to Unravelling, and no longer grants You cannot Recharge Energy Shield, or Mana Leech effects also Recover Energy Shield. Instead, it now grants Chaos Damage from Hits also Contributes to Ignite Chance and Magnitude, Freeze Buildup, or Shock Chance, changing every 2 seconds.

NEW: Combat Frenzy: Quality now provides 0-10% chance when you gain a Charge to gain an additional Charge (previously 0-20%). Now gains a Frenzy Charge when you Freeze, Electrocute or Pin an enemy, no more than once every 7.3-6.1 seconds at Gem levels 8-20 (previously 5.3-4.1 seconds).

Fangs of Frost: Explosion now causes 150% more Freeze Buildup at Level 1 (previously 50%) and gains 9% more per Level (previously 6%). Quality now provides 0-15% chance to not consume Parried Debuff, instead of +0-4 to Melee Strike Range.

Fireball: No longer creates secondary Firebolt projectiles by default. Instead, it can Consume a Fire Infusion to do so. Now has a minimum Gem level of 3 (previously 9). Primary projectile and explosion now deal 15-22 damage at Gem level 3 (previously 9-14), scaling up to 242-362 damage at Gem level 20 (previously 135-202). Secondary projectiles now deal 22-33 damage at Gem level 3 (previously 10-15), scaling up to 404-606 damage at Gem level 20 (previously 145-218). Secondary projectiles can now hit the same target as the primary projectile.

NEW: Freezing Salvo: Spread has been increased by 25% Now fires an additional arrow at each Ice Fragment near its target location. Now has an Attack Damage of 68-150% at Gem levels 5-20 (previously 78-172%). Now accumulates a missile every 0.75 seconds at all Gem levels (previously 1-0.8 seconds at Gem levels 5-20), and now accumulates up to 10 additional missiles (previously 12). Quality now provides 0-40% more Freeze Buildup (previously Delay between missile accumulation is 0 to -0.2 seconds shorter).

Glacial Cascade: No longer has Consumes Freeze on enemies to deal 350% more Damage. It now Consumes Freeze on non-Unique enemies to deal 150% more Damage, and Consumes Freeze on Unique enemies to deal 500% more Damage. Burst Radius is now 0.6 metres (previously 0.5 metres). The Final Burst Radius is now 0.9-1.2 metres at Gem levels 1-20 (previously 0.7 metres at all Gem levels). Quality now provides Gain 0-15% of Physical Damage as Cold Damage (previously 0-10%).

Hailstorm Rounds: Bolts now fall in an expanding circle rather than overlapping with each other. Now has an Impact radius of 1 metre (previously 1.2), and a Rain radius of 4.0 metres (previously 2.5). One bolt now falls every 0.1 seconds (previously 0.3), and there is no longer a minimum distance the bolts can land from the firing location. Now deals 146-254% off Attack Damage at Gem levels 11-20 (previously 109-204%), and has 130-157% more Freeze Buildup. Ammunition now has 100% more reload speed (previously 50% less).
Permafrost Bolts: Now has 200-504% more Freeze Buildup at Gem levels 1-20 (previously 80% at all Gem levels). Now has 17-49% Attack Damage at Gem levels 1-20 (previously 17-62%).

Skeletal Brute: Has a new Command Skill: Shattering Roar. Shattering Roar is a Warcry that Intimidates nearby enemies and Consumes Freeze on enemies and allies to deal damage in an area around those targets. Boneshatter attack now deals 50% more Damage on the initial Strike and 100% more Damage on the Shockwave. Quality now provides Minions cause 0-40% more Stun buildup (previously 0-20%).
Wave of Frost: Now Freezes Enemies that are Primed for Freeze.
The Death's Harp Unique Bow now has +20-25% to Critical Damage Bonus (previously +30-40%). Existing items can be made worse with a Divine Orb.
NEW: The Icetomb Unique Body Armour now grants Gain Cold Thorns equal to 10-18% of your Maximum Mana, instead of Freeze as though dealing Cold Damage equal to 10% of your Maximum Mana when Hit.
Soul Core of Tzamoto grants Martial Weapons 30% increased Freeze Buildup (previously 20%).

Combat Frenzy: Quality now provides 0-10% chance when you gain a Charge to gain an additional Charge (previously 0-20%). Now gains a Frenzy Charge when you Freeze, Electrocute or Pin an enemy, no more than once every 7.3-6.1 seconds at Gem levels 8-20 (previously 5.3-4.1 seconds).

Freezing Salvo: Spread has been increased by 25% Now fires an additional arrow at each Ice Fragment near its target location. Now has an Attack Damage of 68-150% at Gem levels 5-20 (previously 78-172%). Now accumulates a missile every 0.75 seconds at all Gem levels (previously 1-0.8 seconds at Gem levels 5-20), and now accumulates up to 10 additional missiles (previously 12). Quality now provides 0-40% more Freeze Buildup (previously Delay between missile accumulation is 0 to -0.2 seconds shorter).
The Icetomb Unique Body Armour now grants Gain Cold Thorns equal to 10-18% of your Maximum Mana, instead of Freeze as though dealing Cold Damage equal to 10% of your Maximum Mana when Hit.
Freezing Salvo: Quality now provides 0-40% more Freeze Buildup (previously Delay between missile accumulation is 0 to -0.2 seconds shorter).
NEW: Freezing Salvo: Quality now provides 0-40% more Freeze Buildup (previously Delay between missile accumulation is 0 to -0.2 seconds shorter).

Glacial Cascade: No longer has Consumes Freeze on enemies to deal 350% more Damage. It now Consumes Freeze on non-Unique enemies to deal 150% more Damage, and Consumes Freeze on Unique enemies to deal 425% more Damage. Burst Radius is now 0.6 metres (previously 0.5 metres). The Final Burst Radius is now 0.9-1.2 metres at Gem levels 1-20 (previously 0.7 metres at all Gem levels). Quality now provides Gain 0-15% of Physical Damage as Cold Damage (previously 0-10%).
of Freeze Time: Now has a value of 2 to 5 (previously 2)).
Updated descriptions of Freeze, Electrocute and Pin buildup on monsters.

Arctic Armour: Now deals 8 to 12 Cold Damage per Stage at Gem level 4 (previously 16 to 24), scaling to 101 to 152 Cold Damage per Stage at Gem level 20 (previously 203 to 304). Now has 100% more Freeze Buildup. Now has 100% more Magnitude of Chill inflicted.

Escape Shot: Now fires 7 Ice Fragment Projectiles (previously 4), fires additional Ice Fragments as it levels up (11 at Level 20) and now deals 60-265% of Attack Damage (previously 55-172%). Ice Fragments now have an Explosion radius of 2 metres (previously 1.5 metres). Now has equal Magnitude of Chill inflicted as Freeze Buildup.

Fangs of Frost: Now has 106-157% more Freeze Buildup (previously 68-107%) at Gem levels 3-20. Explosion now has 212-314% more Freeze Buildup (previously 304-428%) at Gem levels 3-20. Now has equal Magnitude of Chill inflicted as Freeze Buildup. Explosion Chilled Ground is now 8 seconds (previously 4).

Frost Wall: Lightning-Infused Frostwall now deals 5 to 103 Lightning Damage at Gem level 9 (previously 4 to 68), scaling up to 23 to 444 Lightning Damage at Gem level 20 (previously 15 to 292). Now has equal Magnitude of Chill inflicted as Freeze Buildup.

Glacial Lance: Frenzy-Charge-Empowered explosion now deals 213-670% of Attack Damage (previously 274-598%) at Gem levels 7-20. Attack speed is now 60% of base (previously 50%). Now has 118-157% more Freeze Buildup (previously 68-107%) at Gem levels 7-20. Explosion now has 168-364% more Freeze Buildup (previously 116-214%) at Gem levels 7-20. Now has equal Magnitude of Chill inflicted as Freeze Buildup. Now Converts 80% of Physical damage to Cold damage (previously 60%).

Hailstorm Rounds: Now stores 40-50 (previously 20-25) bolts at Gem level 11-20 . Now has an Attack Damage of 132-228% (previously 146-254%) at Gem levels 11-20. Now has 150% more reload speed (previously 100%). Now has equal Magnitude of Chill inflicted as Freeze Buildup.

Ice Shot: Now converts 80% of Physical damage to Cold damage (previously 70%). Cone Angle increased by approximately 50%. Now has 25% more Freeze buildup. Now deals 178-344% of Attack Damage at Gem levels 9-20 (previously 173-296%). Quality now grants 0-30% more Magnitude of Chill inflicted (previously 0-20% more Attack Damage). Shards now has fires 9-11 Projectiles (previously 6-8). Shards now deals 178-344% of Attack Damage at Gem levels 9-20 (previously 137-234%).

Permafrost Bolts: Now has Projectiles Pierce 2 targets at Gem level 1 scaling to Projectiles Pierce 5 targets at Gem level 24. Base projectile speed has been increased by 50%. Now has equal Magnitude of Chill inflicted as Freeze Buildup.
Spear of Solaris: Removed Generates 100% of Monster Power as Glory for this Skill on Heavy Stunning an enemy. Now generates 1 Glory when you inflict Freeze, Shock or Ignite on an enemy.
Wave of Frost: Now can be used to cancel other actions. Now has equal Magnitude of Chill inflicted as Freeze Buildup.
Hyrri's Ire now has "25% Increased Freeze Duration On Enemies". Existing items will not have this change.
"of Freeze Time" now grants "Slaying Rare Monsters in Map pauses the Delirium Mirror Timer for 3 to 5 seconds" (previously 2 to 5).
Fixed an issue where the Headhunter Unique was sharing visual effects from The Flesh Poppet Unique.

The Shackles of the Wretched Unique Gloves can no longer roll Elemental Ailments other than Freeze you inflict at Reflected to you, instead now being able to roll 10-15% increased Damage per Curse on you.

The of Overpowering Waystone Modifier no longer causes Monsters to have increased Freeze Buildup, Shock Chance, or inflict increased Flammability Magnitude. It now causes Monsters to have increased Elemental Ailment Application.

The Wyvern's Breath Notable Passive Skill has been updated and now provides 40% increased Elemental Ailment Application if you have Shapeshifted to an Animal form Recently. This now also applies to Freeze Buildup, but it is otherwise identical.
Freezing Salvo: Now has 34-68% more Magnitude of Chill inflicted and more Freeze Buildup at Gem levels 3-20 (previously 56-107%).
Ice Shot: Ice Shards no longer have 25% more Freeze Buildup.

Bhatair's Vengeance: When you Freeze a target with Supported Skills, for each 2 Rage you have, you and Allies in your Presence gain 1% of Damage as Cold Damage for 15 seconds (previously for each 1 Rage you have, for 20 seconds).
The Death's Harp Unique Bow no longer has Bow Attacks Fire 3 Additional Arrows, instead it now has +250-330% Surpassing Chance to Fire an Additional Arrow.

Added a new On the Wind multichoice Keystone Atlas Passive, granting the option between Azmeri Spirits with 50% increased Movement Speed, or Azmeri Spirits no longer dematerialising when there are no players nearby.

The Partial Translations Atlas Master option has been redesigned. Instead of granting 20% chance for double effect of Explicit Modifiers on Tablets, it now grants Randomly gain between 0 and 40% increased effect of Explicit Modifiers on Tablets.
Mortuary Map, which is only available through the Unexpected Missions Jado Atlas Master option now allows you to replace a Limb (the same as in Atziri's Temple) at the end of the Map Boss Fight.
Added various indicators to help guide players to use an Ancient Mechanism after defeating the Arbiter of Divinity.
Queen's Rituals from the Mysterious Rites Atlas Passive now have 10 additional Omens in the first set of Favours.
The Mysterious Rites Atlas Passive now describes all of the other bonuses the Queen's Ritual previously had as well.
Added a new Necrotic Catalyst which adds quality that enhances Minion Modifiers on a Ring or Amulet. There is also a Refined Necrotic Catalyst, both of which are available through the Genesis Tree.
Halved the amount of Toughness that Unique Enemies in the Fog gain during Delirium Encounters.
Halved the amount of Increased Damage that Normal, Magic and Rare Enemies in the Fog gain during Delirium Encounters.

Delirium Shards on the Bar now spawn when you get to the correct depth, as opposed to slightly earlier. They also now placed better when spawning to be less likely to be directly on the players location.
Delirium Mirror Shards spawned from hitting depth targets on the Bar no longer persist after a Delirium encounter ends.

Bond Rune in Remnant Encounters has been changed. It still causes Rare monsters in each wave to transfer Modifiers on Death, however it now spawns fewer Rare Monsters overall (especially when paired with a Power Rune) but the number of Modifiers the Rare Monsters can have goes up per wave.

The Prismatic Rune in Remnant Encounters no longer provides Always Shocks to Monsters, and the resistances granted to Monsters by this has been reduced. It also now provides All Damage contributes to Flammability and Ignite Magnitude to Monsters. The damage gained as a random element benefit has been removed, but this is still present when Empowered by a Power Rune.
Every section of the Ocean revealed by an Expedition Logbook is now guaranteed to contain at least one Grand Expedition.
The Runemastered Ornate Ringmail Body Armour basetype now has 725 Armour, 206 Energy Shield, and 130 Ward (previously 210 Armour, 60 Energy Shield, 112 Ward).
The Runemastered Venerable Defender Shield basetype that provides Energy Shield now has Energy Shield values of 135 (previously 56).
Farrow can now be invited to your Hideout in the Runes of Aldur Leagues.
The Journey to the East Quest item now provides more direction on what to do with it, and can now only be turned in to Dannig in the Ruins of Kingsmarch.
Transcendent Alloy can no longer be applied to Foci and Wands.

Siora, Blade of the Mists now has more wind-up time on her Cyclone and Chaos Strike Skills. Their Cyclone skill is now unblockable (red flash), while the Chaos Strike can now be blocked. The damage of their Lighting Strike skill, Cyclone skill, melee attacks and combos has been reduced, and a cooldown has also been added to their melee combo skill. These changes also apply to variations of this boss.
Reduced the damage of the Cannon Barrage and both Slam skills used by Malgor, the Nautilord. This also applies to variations of this boss.
Reduced the damage of the Flame Geysers and both Slams skills used by Serath, the Scaled One. This also applies to variations of this boss.
Significantly reduced the damage of Chaos Volatiles from Ritual Altar encounters and Monster Modifiers.
Reduced the damage of the Fireball skill used by the Krell Skullcrawler Runic Monster.
Reduced the damage of the Snipe skill used by the Cultist Archer Monster.
Reduced the damage of the channeled cold beam skill used by the Blackblooded Elite Abyss Monster.
Reduced the damage of the Fire beam skill from the Lightless Vengewing Abyss Monster.
Reduced the damage of the shade form explosion from the Lightless Moray Abyss Monster as well as its flamethrower attack.
Reduced the damage of the Slam and Lightning Strike skills used by the Strider of the Pit Abyss Monster.
Reduced the damage of the Electric Lightning Flail skill used by Delirium Monsters with the Scatter Storm Modifier.
Reduced the damage of the triple Slam skill used by the Fury Delirium Monster.
Reduced the damage and attack speed of the Pure Fury Delirium Monster.
Significantly reduced the damage of the Rage and Malice Delirium Monsters.

Significantly reduced the damage on the Chaos Beam from the It That Hates Breach Monster. They also no longer fire chaos projectiles at range, and instead now uses a Melee combo if you are in a close proximity.
Fireballs shot by turrets in the Trials of the Sekhemas no longer create an invisible area of effect explosion when they collide with something.
The Spirit Walker's Bear Spirit companion now has a base presence radius of 8 metres (previously 4 metres).
The Smash to Smithereens Skill, granted by the Facebreaker Unique Gloves when transformed by the Martial Artist's Way of the Stonefist Passive Skill, now explicitly states that it has no sockets.
The Zarokh's Gift Passive Skill now grants a Sinister Jewel Socket (previously Jewel Socket).

The Ice Storm Notable Passive now has 15% reduced Effect of Chill on you, and 15% increased Magnitude of Chill you inflict. It no longer provides Unaffected by Chilled Ground, which was non-functional.

The Lightning Storm Notable Passive now has 15% reduced Effect of Shock on you, and 15% increased Magnitude of Shock you inflict. It no longer provides Unaffected by Shocked Ground, which was non-functional.
Bitter Dead now has a base Critical Strike chance of 12%.

Effects that prevent players from recovering Life, Mana or Energy Shield except in specific ways, such as Vaal Pact, Cat O' Nine Tails or Indigon, no longer prevent recovery caused by core game systems (including but not limited to: checkpoints, healing wells, levelling up). This also means that changing areas while you have one of these effects can no longer cause you to lose Life, Mana or Energy Shield. Effects that prevent all forms of recovery (such as Lich's Eternal Life) have not received this change.
Flames now point towards the location of the Boss in The Azak Bog upon completing the Flameskin Ritual in the area.
Devour can no longer consume living players. Liches are friends, not food!
Improved the visibility of Rogue Exiles, as well as their behaviour. They should now also not have their Life Bars appear when they are so far away.
Improved Conductive Runes' description to explicitly state that its damage is not based on your weapon's damage.
An effect is now played on characters when gaining a Shrine buff.
Fixed a rare case where the Immured Fury Quest Map could be hidden in the fog of war.
Fixed a bug where the Verisium Anvil would not preview the effects of Augments when Runeforging.
Fixed a bug where all versions of Runemastered Eyes of the Runefather were Bucklers, rather than only the version with Parry.

Fixed a bug where you would be unable to see the "A Garment of Rings" dialogue option with Dannig if you had migrated from Solo Self-Found or Hardcore without also migrating your league process and stashes.
Fixed a bug where Warding Rune of Nourishment was not obtainable as a runic inscription reward.
Fixed a bug where Conductive Runes would deal no damage if you had certain two handed weapon types equipped.
Fixed a bug where Conductive Runes' damage did not scale with modifiers to hazard damage.
Fixed a bug where you could be teleported out of Ritual encounters when fighting The Fungus Behemoth.
Fixed a bug where the Mist Ravens summoned by The Raven's Flock Unique Staff did not count as allies in your presence.
Fixed a bug where Fleeing Rogue Exiles sometimes did not drop loot.
Fixed a bug where Rogue Exiles could sometimes stray from the Essence crystal they were supposed to be contained in.
Fixed a bug where the Unique Helmet Decree of Acuity did not provide Runic Ward upon Runeforging in the Verisium Anvil.
Fixed a bug which could cause some skills to be unusable in Abyssal Depths.
Fixed a bug which could cause triggered skills to be invisible while shapeshifted in Abyssal Depths. This was most commonly encountered with Shred's Ice Fragments.
Fixed a bug where Warbringer's Warcaller's Bellow Ascendancy Passive Skill could sometimes explode the same corpse an unlimited number of times.
Fixed a bug where Aldur's Legacy could not be socketed into the Runeseeker's Call Unique Runic Fork.
Fixed a bug where Briarpatch could not be supported by Support Gems that require Skills to deal damage.

Fixed a bug where Support Gems that cause Skills to consume Charges, or Armour Break or Elemental Ailments on an enemy, were not mutually exclusive with other Support Gems that consume the same thing.
Fixed a bug where a number of Support Gems that add Charge-consumption behaviour to Skills did not allow Support Gems that modify Charge consumption to be socketed into the Skill.
Fixed a bug where some Minions could not be supported by Minion Splash.
Fixed a bug where the small Passive Skills leading up to the Everlasting Infusions and Empowering Infusions Notable Passive Skills were swapped.
Fixed a bug where the Skeletal Brute's Shattering Roar command skill did not intimidate enemies.

Fixed a bug where the Quality bonus granted to Molten Blast by the Gemling Legionnaire's Advanced Thaumaturgy Passive Skill granted 1 less Projectile than intended and displayed on the wrong tab of the Gem.

Fixed a bug where the Forgotten Wardens' percentage of Damage from Deflected Hits is taken from Damageable Companion's Life before you was not functioning correctly. This fixes the reported case where players using Forgotten Warden with a Stoat Idol socketed into it would die unexpectedly.
Fixed a bug where the Disciple of Varashta's Djinn could display Rage visual effects.
Fixed a bug where some Delirium monsters were missing audio.
Fixed an issue where The Raven dialogue could be stuck on a specific line when entering Delirium Mirrors.
Fixed a bug where Fire-Infused Comet did not deal damage with the Abyssal Comet Skill Effect microtraction equipped.

The Soul Core of Tzamoto now has a Limit of 1. It now grants 60% increased Freeze Buildup when socketed into a Martial Weapon (previously 30%), and +2% to Maximum Cold Resistance when socketed into a Helmet (previously +1%).
